=Act as a long-term investor. Use a comprehensive analysis of the stock with the ticker symbol: {{ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.ticker }}

Here is financial data to help you do the following research. It has 3 months of past prices, income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow statement of past 4 years: {{ $('get_stock_data.py Deep').item.json.stdout }}

Here is 10 articles showing recent news of the company. You can use this for sentiment anaylsis as I describe below: {{ $json.cleaned_news_data }}

Analyze and research through the following things before you give your response. Do not necesarily include these in your response, just use this as a checklist of how to anaylze the company.:

1) Industry Potential

2) Product Potential

3) Competition

4) Business Model

5) Leadership

6) Financials of the company, including balance sheet, cash flow statement, income statement of previous months and years, and P/E ratio and EPS.

7) How profitable the company is, and how good it is at minimizing debt

8) Recent news/public sentiment anaylsis

9) Size of audience/market

10) Valuation of the company using a DCF analysis.

11) Deep technical analysis of the stock. Use previous stock price data of the last 3 months, and use knowledge of chart patterns, and all types of technical indicators, volume analysis, etc.

Response Format:

Company: put the company name and then ticker symbol

1 Quarter Outlook: Create this outlook based off more short term factors. use the chart patterns, deep technical anaylsis, volume analysis, public sentiment analysis, recent news, current market conditions, etc. Keep the response to 2-3 sentences.

1 Year Outlook: Create this outlook based off medium term factors. Use the recent news, current market conditions, predictions for market conditions in the next year, financials of the company, valuation of the company, competition, strength of their business model, leadership, recent growth. Keep the response to 2-3 sentences.

5 Year Outlook: Create this outlook based off long term factors. Use industry potential, product potential, size of market/audience in the future, financials, how good the company is at maximizing profit and minimizing debt, leadership, and competition. Keep the response to 2-3 sentences.

Risk Rating: First put the rating out of 10 (Example: 7/10). Then explain why in terms of the analysis checklist above. Keep the response length to a short paragraph.

Long Term Investment Rating: First put the rating out of 10 (Example: 7/10). Then explain why in terms of the analysis checklist above. Keep the response length to a short paragraph.

keep your response to the format specified above only and no bold words.
